decks.notes: The main idea of this Golgari Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells. By utilizing cards like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Overlord of the Balemurk, the deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and pressure the opponent. Cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Scavenging Ooze provide additional utility and graveyard interaction to further support the aggressive strategy. With a focus on early creature drops and consistent damage output, this deck aims to close out games swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells, utilizing a combination of red and blue spells. It aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, while also having access to card draw and potential finishers like Glacial Dragonhunt and Tersa Lightshatter. The deck includes a mix of creatures with abilities that help maintain tempo and evasion, as well as burn spells to deal direct damage and clear opposing threats. It is designed to be fast-paced and proactive in nature, aiming to close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of aggressive creature plays and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By playing efficient threats like Deep-Cavern Bat and Spyglass Siren, while also controlling the board with cards like Go for the Throat and Faerie Mastermind, the deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain pressure throughout the game. Additionally, cards like Enduring Curiosity and Tishana's Tidebinder provide card advantage and tempo swings to keep the opponent on the back foot. Overall, this deck aims to win the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. It aims to control the board with efficient spell casting and dealing damage directly to the opponent. The key strategy is to maintain a consistent flow of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal spells. By combining creature aggression with direct damage, the deck seeks to establish dominance early in the game and maintain pressure until victory is achieved.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board using a combination of creature removal spells and powerful creatures with disruptive abilities. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive creatures like Floodpits Drowner and Spyglass Siren, while using cards like Go for the Throat and Cut Down to remove any threats from the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Anoint with Affliction and Faebloom Trick provide additional utility and versatility, allowing the deck to adapt to different situations and outmaneuver the opponent.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Rubblebelt Maverick. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Insidious Roots and Disruptive Stormbrood to control the board and protect your creatures. By utilizing cards like Cache Grab and Dredger's Insight, the deck can maintain card advantage and outvalue the opponent. With a mix of land ramp, creature recursion, and powerful threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive mono green aggro build. Utilizing cards like Mossborn Hydra and Bushwhack to build up strong board presence and deal damage efficiently. Llanowar Elves and Sazh's Chocobo provide ramp and additional resources to keep the pressure on. Snakeskin Veil offers protection for key creatures, while Escape Tunnel provides flexibility in combat. The deck aims to win the game quickly by utilizing its aggressive creatures and combat tricks.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and drawing cards to maintain card advantage. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan and establish control over the board. Additionally, the deck features powerful finishers like Ultima and Elspeth, Storm Slayer to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and ensure consistency in casting spells.

This deck focuses on a fast-paced aggressive strategy utilizing a combination of creatures with disruptive abilities and powerful spells. By controlling the board with cards like Floodpits Drowner and Spyglass Siren, while also applying pressure with creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Azure Beastbinder, the goal is to overwhelm opponents quickly. The inclusion of Faerie Mastermind and Faebloom Trick provide additional versatility and options. The overall strategy is to outpace opponents and maintain momentum to secure a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of aggressive creatures and low-cost removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By maintaining board control with cards like Faerie Mastermind and Floodpits Drowner, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Cut Down and Go for the Throat, the deck aims to finish the game quickly before the opponent can establish a strong defense. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Anoint with Affliction and Into the Flood Maw provides additional ways to apply pressure and punish the opponent's board presence.

The main concept of the deck is to use a combination of spells and creatures that can deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent, with a focus on instant-speed interactions. The deck utilizes a mix of burn spells, card draw, and creatures with evasion to apply pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. The mana base is optimized for casting both red and blue spells, allowing for flexibility in the types of threats and answers that can be deployed each turn.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Spyglass Siren and Floodpits Drowner, along with removal spells like Go for the Throat, the deck aims to control the board and keep the opponent on the defensive. Enduring Curiosity and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide card advantage and additional threats, while Phantom Interference and Faerie Mastermind disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor to close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Mosswood Dreadknight and Sentinel of the Nameless City, supported by removal spells like Go for the Throat and Maelstrom Pulse. The strategy also includes using mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and efficient land cards like Wastewood Verge to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Thrun, Breaker of Silence adds a strong late-game presence to ensure victory. With a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells, this Golgari Aggro deck aims to dominate the board and secure a fast victory.

This Jeskai Aggro deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with aggressive creatures like Imodane's Recruiter, Knight-Errant of Eos, and Spyglass Siren, while also disrupting the opponent's board with cards like Gleeful Demolition and Novice Inspector. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early on with efficient creatures and removal spells, while maintaining card advantage with cards like Resolute Reinforcements and Warden of the Inner Sky. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan, ensuring that you can cast your spells on curve and keep up the pressure on your opponent.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cheap and efficient spells like Abrade and Torch the Tower to control the board while playing powerful creatures like Vivi Ornitier and Ral, Crackling Wit to deal damage and pressure the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency in playing threats and removal spells. The goal is to maintain tempo and pressure the opponent until victory is achieved.

This deck focuses on a diverse array of powerful creatures and legendary creatures from multiple colors, aiming to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and high-value creatures. By utilizing a mix of efficient creatures and mana-fixing lands, the deck can quickly apply pressure and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game. The inclusion of powerful legendary creatures like Sephiroth and Alesha adds synergy and versatility to the deck, allowing for different strategic options depending on the situation. Overall, the deck is designed to consistently apply pressure and out-tempo the opponent to secure victory.
